sample: Exactly the six positive universe cases and three unique invalid variants; deduplicate unchanged P1/M1/I1 controls by SHA256. One source-only comparison; no checker/model/proof/mutant launch.
inventory: Read immutable Git blobs. Nanoda: all src/test_resources plus README,Cargo.toml,LICENSE. Arena: all textual tests/tutorial .lean/.ndjson/.yaml/.json/.md and toolchain files plus README,lka.py,test schema and CI discovery. Retain complete tracked-path inventory, selected source archives and literal-fixture-byte comparisons. Excluded infrastructure/binary files and external/generated library corpora remain explicit boundaries.
classification: Literal duplicate requires identical complete fixture bytes. Equivalent coverage requires a concrete assertion or expected-result test demanding the same behavior. Related helpers, production implementation, keyword matches and incidental library imports do not alone demonstrate the exact test obligation. Supported gap claims apply only to the inspected pinned snapshot/suite; external/generated content prevents global absence claims.
decision: Recommend the smallest useful subset with a named consumer/insertion point, or retain locally and stop universe expansion. A source-level gap is not a current bug or runtime fault-sensitivity result.
cost: One deterministic inventory command and model source interpretation; retain output counts/elapsed time and available usage, mark unavailable task token/cost accounting. No new general harness, formal model or routine independent review.
